item.title: fix(comfy): forward req.timeoutMs in music generation (#123444)
item.summary: fix(comfy): forward req.timeoutMs in music generation (#123444) The Comfy music provider dropped req.timeoutMs when calling runComfyWorkflow, while the image and video providers forward it. Request-level timeouts (mediaModels.music.timeoutMs, tool parameter) were silently ignored: shorter values had no effect and longer ones still failed at the hardcoded 300s default. Punchcard-Session: coral-harbor-river-yv
